tables.name: raw_mobimed_invoices
tables.description: Patient invoices exported monthly from the Mobimed practice-management system. One row per invoice. German column names, semicolon CSV feed, dates as dd.mm.yyyy strings.
policies: prefer stg_mobimed_invoices for analytics: it has typed dates, the derived category and the entity tag; this raw table keeps dd.mm.yyyy date strings
rows with a non-empty Stornogrund are cancelled invoices - exclude them from revenue unless the user asks for cancellations
the arithmetic invariant is SummeUmsatzinklUSt = Umsatz0 + Umsatz10 + Umsatz20 + MwSt10 + MwSt20

columns.name: Datum
columns.description: Invoice date as a dd.mm.yyyy string; parse with strptime before date arithmetic

columns.name: Rechnungsnummer
columns.description: Invoice number: 3-letter prefix + year + 5-digit sequence (e.g. UNI2026-00042). The prefix drives the category rule: UNI=UNIQA, AME=AMED, PRO=own products, others=normal invoices

columns.name: Patient
columns.description: Patient full name

columns.name: Patientenkategorie
columns.description: Patient segment label, e.g. UNIQA Versichert, AMED Firmenkunde, Selbstzahler, Wahlarzt

columns.name: Positionen
columns.description: Billed positions as one text field; an invoice can contain several treatments or products

columns.name: SummeUmsatzinklUSt
columns.description: Gross invoice total in EUR including VAT

columns.name: Umsatz0
columns.description: Net revenue at 0 percent VAT (exempt medical services)

columns.name: Umsatz10
columns.description: Net revenue at 10 percent VAT (e.g. supplements)

columns.name: Umsatz20
columns.description: Net revenue at 20 percent VAT (e.g. cosmetics, devices, attests)

columns.name: MwSt10
columns.description: VAT amount at 10 percent, equals 10 percent of Umsatz10

columns.name: MwSt20
columns.description: VAT amount at 20 percent, equals 20 percent of Umsatz20

columns.name: Stornogrund
columns.description: Cancellation reason; empty string means the invoice is valid

columns.name: Invoice_open
columns.description: True when the invoice is still unpaid (open accounts receivable)

tables.name: raw_mobimed_payments
tables.description: Front-desk payment receipts from Mobimed. One row per receipt. Dates are dd.mm.yyyy strings.

measures.name: receipts_total
measures.description: Total collected at the front desk

policies: Hobex receipts are card-terminal payments: they are settled daily in raw_hobex_settlements grouped by ClearingDate, and the settlement net lands on the bank statement one day later

columns.name: belegnr
columns.description: Receipt number, year-scoped sequence (BEL2026-00001)

columns.name: belegdatum
columns.description: Receipt date as dd.mm.yyyy string

columns.name: Payment_Category
columns.description: Payment method: Hobex = card terminal, Banküberweisung = bank transfer, Barzahlung = cash, Kartenzahlung = card

columns.name: ClearingDate
columns.description: Date the payment cleared, dd.mm.yyyy string; the grouping key for Hobex settlements

tables.name: raw_chargebee_subscriptions
tables.description: Individual healthcare memberships from Chargebee. One row per subscription with the customer embedded.

measures.name: total_mrr
measures.description: Monthly recurring revenue of the membership base

columns.name: customer_name
columns.description: Member full name

columns.name: customer_email
columns.description: Member e-mail address

columns.name: mrr
columns.description: Monthly recurring revenue of this subscription; annual plans are divided by 12

tables.name: raw_chargebee_invoices
tables.description: Membership invoices from Chargebee with line items. Grain: one row per invoice LINE; invoice-level fields (total, dates, status) repeat on every line of the same invoice.

measures.name: membership_gross_billed
measures.description: Gross billed amount; additive across lines and equal to the sum of invoice totals

policies: one row per invoice line: for invoice-level counts or totals deduplicate by invoice_number first, otherwise multi-line invoices are double counted
void invoices are not revenue - exclude them unless the user asks
the MR prefix of invoice_number is how bank statement references identify Chargebee payments

columns.name: invoice_number
columns.description: Membership invoice number, MR + year + 5-digit sequence (MR2026-00001)

columns.name: customer_name
columns.description: Member full name

columns.name: service_period_start
columns.description: Start of the period this invoice pays for; basis for revenue timing (deferred revenue)

columns.name: service_period_end
columns.description: End of the paid service period; annual memberships span 12 months

columns.name: total
columns.description: Invoice-level gross total; repeated on every line of the invoice

columns.name: pdf_url
columns.description: Link to the invoice PDF (the actual bill)

tables.name: raw_chargebee_credit_notes
tables.description: Chargebee credit notes (MRGS numbers) - negative invoices that reverse part or all of a membership invoice. One row per credit note.
policies: credit note amounts are stored positive; subtract them from invoice revenue for net figures

columns.name: credit_note_number
columns.description: Credit note number, MRGS + year + sequence

columns.name: reference_invoice_number
columns.description: The MR invoice this credit note reverses

tables.name: raw_chargebee_transactions
tables.description: Chargebee payment transactions. One row per gateway payment of a membership invoice; the gateway is always Stripe, so every transaction has a matching Stripe charge.

columns.name: gateway
columns.description: Payment gateway; always stripe - Stripe is the payment rail underneath Chargebee

columns.name: gateway_txn_id
columns.description: The Stripe charge id this transaction became; join key into raw_stripe_charges

tables.name: raw_stripe_charges
tables.description: Stripe card charges. One row per charge. Two businesses blend in this one account: Chargebee membership payments and the weight-loss program - source_class separates them.

measures.name: charged_gross
measures.description: Gross card volume before Stripe fees

dimensions.name: by_source_class
dimensions.description: Which business the charge belongs to

policies: always split or filter by source_class - memberships and the weight program share this Stripe account and mixing them misstates both revenue streams

columns.name: source_class
columns.description: chargebee = membership payment routed through Chargebee; medcenter_weight = weight-program sale

columns.name: source_invoice_number
columns.description: The originating invoice: an MR number for chargebee charges, a MEDWEIGHT number for weight charges

columns.name: customer_name
columns.description: Cardholder name

tables.name: raw_stripe_balance_transactions
tables.description: Stripe balance movements. One row per charge with the Stripe fee and the net amount that will be paid out; net = amount - fee.

measures.name: net_after_fees
measures.description: Amount that reaches the bank after fees

policies: the fee column explains gross-versus-net differences between charged amounts and the bank statement

columns.name: available_on
columns.description: Date the net amount becomes available for payout, typically 2 days after the charge

columns.name: payout_id
columns.description: The weekly payout this balance movement is bundled into

tables.name: raw_stripe_payouts
tables.description: Weekly Stripe payouts to the bank. One row per payout; the amount equals the sum of the net amounts of its balance transactions and appears on the bank statement as a STRIPE credit on the arrival date.
policies: to explain a payout, join raw_stripe_balance_transactions on payout_id and follow charge_id back to the charges and their invoices

columns.name: arrival_date
columns.description: Date the payout lands on the Erste Bank statement

tables.name: raw_stripe_invoices
tables.description: Weight-loss program invoices (MEDWEIGHT numbers), billed upfront through Stripe. One row per invoice.
policies: void invoices enter the accounting import as negative rows; exclude them from revenue otherwise
programs are billed upfront for 1 to 6 months - use the service period columns for revenue timing

columns.name: invoice_number
columns.description: Weight-program invoice number, MEDWEIGHT-year-sequence

columns.name: customer_name
columns.description: Program participant name

columns.name: service_period_start
columns.description: Start of the prepaid program period

columns.name: service_period_end
columns.description: End of the prepaid program period

columns.name: pdf_url
columns.description: Link to the invoice PDF (the actual bill)

tables.name: raw_zoho_contacts
tables.description: Business customers invoiced through Zoho Books: companies buying occupational health services, corporate memberships, and insurers. One row per customer.

columns.name: legal_entity
columns.description: Which medcenter legal entity serves this customer: medcenter_gmbh or medcenter_labs

columns.name: email
columns.description: Accounting contact e-mail

tables.name: raw_zoho_invoices
tables.description: B2B invoices from Zoho Books with line positions. Grain: one row per invoice LINE; invoice-level fields (total, balance, status, dates) repeat on every line.

measures.name: b2b_gross_billed
measures.description: Gross billed amount; additive across lines and equal to the sum of invoice totals

policies: one row per invoice line: deduplicate by invoice_number for invoice-level figures, otherwise multi-line invoices are double counted
draft and void invoices are not revenue
balance is the open (unpaid) remainder of the invoice - the basis for accounts receivable and payment reminders
the FK prefix of invoice_number is how bank statement references identify Zoho payments
cf_service_start and cf_service_end are the service-period custom fields that power deferred-revenue timing

columns.name: invoice_number
columns.description: B2B invoice number, FK + year + 5-digit sequence (FK2026-00001)

columns.name: cf_service_start
columns.description: Custom field: start of the contracted service period

columns.name: cf_service_end
columns.description: Custom field: end of the contracted service period; spans 1 to 12 months

columns.name: balance
columns.description: Open amount still unpaid on this invoice; 0 when fully paid

columns.name: legal_entity
columns.description: medcenter_gmbh or medcenter_labs - determines which bank account receives the payment

columns.name: pdf_url
columns.description: Link to the invoice PDF (the actual bill)

tables.name: raw_zoho_payments
tables.description: Customer payments recorded in Zoho Books. One row per payment, applied to one invoice; paid by bank transfer, so each payment has a matching bank statement credit.

columns.name: invoice_numbers_applied
columns.description: The FK invoice this payment settles

tables.name: raw_zoho_credit_notes
tables.description: Zoho credit notes (CN numbers) reversing part of a paid B2B invoice. One row per credit note; amounts stored positive.

tables.name: raw_erste_camt053
tables.description: Erste Bank statement entries parsed from camt.053. One row per statement line across both accounts (one IBAN per legal entity). Amounts are always positive; credit_debit gives the direction.
policies: amounts are always positive - use credit_debit (CRDT = money in, DBIT = money out) for direction, never the sign
remittance_structured carries the paid invoice number: MR prefix means Chargebee, FK prefix means Zoho; prefer mart_bank_reconciliation which has this matching precomputed
counterparty HOBEX AG credits are daily card-terminal settlements; STRIPE PAYMENTS credits are weekly Stripe payouts

columns.name: account_iban
columns.description: Receiving account; AT61...3201 belongs to medcenter_gmbh, AT05...5432 to medcenter_labs

columns.name: remittance_structured
columns.description: Structured payment reference; carries the invoice number when the payer entered it correctly

columns.name: remittance_unstructured
columns.description: Free-text payment reference; mangled or partial invoice references end up here

columns.name: counterparty_name
columns.description: Payer or payee name; members paying by transfer appear with their personal name

tables.name: raw_domonda_invoices
tables.description: Supplier (purchase) invoices from the Domonda invoice inbox. One row per document; the payable side of the business.
policies: paid supplier invoices reappear as DBIT lines on the bank statement with the supplier as counterparty

columns.name: account_assignment
columns.description: Expense account the invoice is booked to (7xxx cost accounts)

columns.name: document_url
columns.description: Link to the scanned invoice document

tables.name: raw_bmd_journal
tables.description: Booking journal exported from BMD, the external accountants' bookkeeping software - the official books. One row per booking; covers both legal entities via company_id.

dimensions.name: by_symbol
dimensions.description: AR = outgoing invoice, ER = incoming supplier invoice

policies: company_id 1 is medcenter_gmbh, company_id 2 is medcenter_labs

AR rows carry the source-system invoice number in document_number: MR numbers come from Chargebee, FK from Zoho, three-letter medical prefixes from Mobimed - this is how the books reconcile back to the source systems
the text column contains patient names - treat this table as personal data

columns.name: booking_symbol
columns.description: AR = Ausgangsrechnung (outgoing invoice), ER = Eingangsrechnung (supplier invoice)

columns.name: document_number
columns.description: Source document number; for AR rows this equals the invoice number in the originating system

columns.name: text
columns.description: Booking text; contains patient or customer names

columns.name: contra_account
columns.description: Contra account: 4100 memberships, 4200 B2B, 4300 patient revenue, 33001 payables

tables.name: raw_hobex_settlements
tables.description: Daily card-terminal settlements from Hobex. One row per terminal per day: transaction count, gross, fee and net; net = gross - fee, and net is credited to the bank the next day.
policies: gross_amount equals the sum of Mobimed Hobex receipts clearing that day; mart_settlement_recon has the three-way comparison against Mobimed and the bank precomputed

tables.name: stg_mobimed_invoices
tables.description: Canonical Mobimed staging table: typed dates, rounded amounts, the derived invoice category and the legal-entity tag. One row per patient invoice. Use this instead of the raw table for analytics.

dimensions.name: by_category
dimensions.description: The canonical business category derived from the invoice-number prefix

policies: category is the single canonical derivation (UNI prefix = UNIQA, AME = AMED, PRO = Eigenprodukte, everything else = Normal_Invoices) - never re-derive it from the invoice number downstream
storno_reason IS NOT NULL marks cancelled invoices - exclude them from revenue unless asked
is_open marks unpaid invoices (open accounts receivable)

columns.name: invoice_month
columns.description: Invoice month as a YYYY-MM string; the standard monthly grouping key

columns.name: patient_name
columns.description: Patient full name

columns.name: category
columns.description: Business category: UNIQA, AMED, Eigenprodukte (own products) or Normal_Invoices

columns.name: legal_entity
columns.description: Owning legal entity; constant medcenter_gmbh for Mobimed

tables.name: mart_mobimed_monthly
tables.description: Monthly patient-revenue mart: one row per month, category and legal entity, with net revenue split by VAT rate (0, 10, 20 percent) and the VAT amounts. Cancelled invoices are included and counted in storno_count.
policies: the Eigenprodukte rows split by VAT rate are the basis of the monthly own-product sales summary and the VAT return

tables.name: mart_revenue_monthly
tables.description: Top-level revenue view: one row per month, source system (chargebee, stripe_weight, zoho, mobimed) and legal entity. Voids, drafts and cancelled invoices are excluded.
policies: this is the first table to reach for any where-does-revenue-come-from question

tables.name: mart_bank_reconciliation
tables.description: Every bank statement line classified: matched to its invoice via the payment reference (MR = Chargebee, FK = Zoho), recognised by counterparty (Hobex settlements, Stripe payouts), outgoing, or left for manual review. One row per statement line.
policies: match_method review is the manual work queue: credits nobody could match automatically - this list is what finance reviews by hand
matched_invoice holds an MR number when matched_system is chargebee and an FK number when it is zoho; join the respective invoice table for details

columns.name: matched_system
columns.description: Where the money came from or went: chargebee, zoho, hobex, stripe_payout, outgoing, or unmatched

columns.name: match_method
columns.description: reference = invoice number found in the payment reference; counterparty = recognised sender; review = needs a human; n/a = outgoing payment

columns.name: matched_invoice
columns.description: The invoice number the payment was matched to, when found

tables.name: mart_open_invoices
tables.description: All unpaid invoices across the three AR systems (chargebee, zoho, mobimed) in one view: one row per open invoice with counterparty, due date and open amount. The basis for payment reminders and AR aging.

columns.name: counterparty
columns.description: Customer, company or patient the invoice is addressed to

columns.name: amount_open
columns.description: Outstanding amount: full total for unpaid invoices, remaining balance for partially paid ones

tables.name: mart_doctor_monthly
tables.description: Doctor billing: one row per month and doctor with gross patient billing, the fee the center retains (30 percent take rate) and the doctor payout. Cancelled invoices excluded.

measures.name: center_fee
measures.description: Fee retained by the center (take rate)

policies: medcenter_fee is a flat 30 percent demo take rate; the real per-doctor rates are a finance-owned rule

tables.name: mart_deferred_revenue
tables.description: Revenue timing: one row per month and system splitting billed amounts into revenue earned in the billing month versus deferred to future months, based on each invoice's service period. billed_total = revenue_current_month + deferred_to_future.

measures.name: deferred
measures.description: Billed now but belonging to future months (e.g. annual memberships)

policies: the split is proportional to calendar days of the service period falling inside the billing month

tables.name: mart_settlement_recon
tables.description: Three-way card-settlement reconciliation: one row per Hobex settlement day comparing the terminal settlement against Mobimed card receipts (delta_gross) and against the bank credit (delta_net). Both deltas should be zero.

measures.name: unexplained_gross
measures.description: Settlement gross not explained by Mobimed receipts

measures.name: unexplained_net
measures.description: Settlement net not found on the bank statement

policies: non-zero delta_gross or delta_net indicates a reconciliation break that needs investigation

global_policies: invoice-number prefixes identify the source system: MR = Chargebee memberships, MRGS = Chargebee credit notes, FK = Zoho B2B, CN = Zoho credit notes, MEDWEIGHT = Stripe weight program, three-letter medical prefixes (UNI, AME, PRO, ORD, ...) = Mobimed patient invoices
the group has two legal entities, medcenter_gmbh and medcenter_labs, each with its own bank account; keep them separate unless the user asks for group totals
there is no shared customer or patient id across systems - never merge identities across sources; matching happens only via explicit invoice-number references
